verdict.rationale: Floot documents 'Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive' as a built-in platform feature, directly supporting scheduled/recurring workflows. However, there is no detail on configuring recurrence, job management UI, retries, or AI-native control (e.g., no MCP tool for creating/editing schedules) beyond a single line mention. Missing for 10: documentation of scheduling syntax/config, AI-driven creation of scheduled jobs via chat/MCP, and independent or hands-on confirmation of reliability.
